reason: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:131-133 the patch adds `if (dateOverrideExist) return true;` before the `busy.every(...)` check at line 151, so a slot inside an override window is never compared against busy times. The fixed-host check (lines 488-493) and the round-robin check (513-518) pass the user's `busy` and `dateOverrides` together, so booked or calendar-busy slots on override days are offered as available.
